meta_data.base_class: Generate an article discussing the applications of AI in a specific <field> - refers to various industries, domains, or problem areas where artificial intelligence technologies can be applied.
meta_data.base_class_entity: applications of AI in the medical field

tool_template.name: aiArticleGen_in_<class>
tool_template.description: Generates an article discussing the applications of AI in a specific <class>.

title.description: The title of the <class> article to be generated.

word_count.description: Approximate word count for the <class> article.

focus_area.description: Specific area of AI applications in <class> to focus on, if any.

target_audience.description: The primary audience the <class> article is intended for, such as professionals, students, or the general public.

language.description: The language in which the <class> article should be written.

reference_style.description: The citation and referencing style to be used in the <class> article, e.g., APA, MLA.

illustrations.description: Indicates whether the <class> article should include illustrations or diagrams.

tone.description: The tone or style of writing for the <class> article, such as formal, informal, or technical.
